exercise.name: Interviews
exercise.description: Gather qualitative data directly from users to understand their needs, motivations, and pain points.

exercise.name: Brainstorm
exercise.description: Generate a wide range of ideas and solutions collaboratively with a human-centric approach.

exercise.name: Insight Scraping
exercise.description: Automatically gather and analyze data from various online sources using AI to uncover actionable insights.

exercise.name: Automated Research
exercise.description: Leverage AI to conduct research tasks like literature reviews, market analysis, or competitive analysis efficiently.

exercise.name: User Testing
exercise.description: Conduct structured testing sessions with real users to validate design decisions and gather feedback on the final product.

exercise.name: Performance Analytics
exercise.description: Use AI-powered analytics tools to synthesize user behavior data, performance metrics, and feedback into actionable insights for product improvement.

exercise.name: AI-Powered Trend Analysis
exercise.description: Use AI to automatically analyze market trends, emerging technologies, and user behavior patterns from large datasets to identify opportunities and threats in the problem space.
prompt_example: Analyze current market trends in [industry/domain] and identify emerging opportunities
What are the key behavioral patterns of users in [target demographic] based on recent data?
Identify potential disruptions or threats in the [problem space] based on technological and market trends

before: Ensure data sources are legitimate and privacy-compliant
Consider potential biases in datasets being analyzed
Verify that trend analysis doesn't reinforce existing inequalities
after: Validate AI findings with human expertise and domain knowledge
Consider the societal impact of identified trends and opportunities
Ensure recommendations don't exclude or harm marginalized groups

chat_history: What ideas did the team generate?
Which ideas align with user needs?
What feedback was received on the prototype?
